purpose: Rebuild NiD3DShaderConstantMap::ApplyConstants 0x009A8E30 (mapped and held in slice constant-maps, re/functions/0x009A8E30.md) as a unit for single-pass stereo's second eye (docs/subsystems/single-pass-stereo.md step 2; the contract in src/engine/render/ConstantReapply.h). The rebuild is the original 1:1 over ports - the map's entry array and entry fields, the extra-data lookup 0x006FF9C0, the map's vtable slots +0x54/+0x58/+0x5C/+0x60/+0x64/+0x6C with the original's argument lists per slot, the device's SetVertexShaderConstantF (+0x178) / SetPixelShaderConstantF (+0x1B4) - identical in its port-call sequence, arguments and result flag when the EntryFilter is kWhole (the 1:1 gate against the emulator's traces), PLUS the one documented deviation of ConstantReapply.h: with EntryFilter::kView only live entries of type 0x20000000 whose id [entry+0x10] satisfies IsViewId are dispatched (slot +0x54, same 11 arguments), every other entry is skipped with no call and no change of the result flag, and the extra-data lookup is not made (LooksUpExtraData). Take the filter as an input of the logic; the kWhole path must not change by its presence. The logic is 64-bit clean (handles as std::uint32_t, no raw pointers); the engine shapes (map +0x10/+0x16/+0x20/+0x28, entry +0x08/+0x10/+0x14/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20/+0x24/+0x30, the slot offsets, the device vtable offsets, 0x006FF9C0, 0x00B29F84) go into the <Name>.h header with static_asserts. Tests: every mapped flow (B1..B15: empty map, null entry in the middle, dead entry ending the walk, register -1 with gate 0 and non-zero, each of the six types, type 0x10000000 with target 1 / 2 / other, a failed HRESULT, a slot returning non-zero, an unknown type, a failure followed by successes), the same flows under kView (only defined view ids dispatched, no lookup, the flag over the dispatched entries only), and the stack-slot reuse the map describes is NOT part of the contract (only the calls, their arguments and the return value are). The emulator gate records the original's traced calls per branch with stub slots and a stub 0x006FF9C0; the rebuild's port-call sequence under kWhole is compared with it.

functions.name: NiD3DShaderConstantMap::ApplyConstants
functions.known: Mapped in slice constant-maps (held): re/functions/0x009A8E30.md, 525 bytes, one loop, fifteen branches B1..B15, every slot target's ret N read in .rdata. thiscall(map; 11 dword arguments), RET 0x2C, returns 0 when every dispatched entry returned 0, else 1.

map.purpose: Applies one shader constant map against one shader program for one draw: stores the program at [this+0x20], looks the geometry's '__NDL_SCMData' extra data up once through NiObjectNET::GetExtraData 0x006FF9C0 (name pointer from 0x00B29F84), then walks the entry pointer array [this+0x10] (count u16 [this+0x16]) in index order; a null entry is skipped, a clear byte [entry+0x08] ends the loop, an entry with register [entry+0x1C] == -1 and [entry+0x24] == 0 is skipped; otherwise the type nibble [entry+0x14] & 0xF0000000 selects: 0x20000000 -> slot +0x54 (a1, entry, a2..a10), 0x10000000 -> with [entry+0x18] == 1 device [this+0x28] vtbl +0x178 (device, [entry+0x1C], [entry+0x30], [entry+0x20]) = SetVertexShaderConstantF, == 2 vtbl +0x1B4 SetPixelShaderConstantF, else slot +0x58 (a1, entry, a10); 0x30000000 -> slot +0x5C (a1, entry, a2..a11, extraData); 0x40000000 -> slot +0x60 (a1, entry, a10); 0x50000000 -> slot +0x64 (a1, entry, a2, a3, a6, a7, a8, a9, a10); 0x60000000 -> slot +0x6C (a1, entry, a2..a10); any other type clears the result flag with no call. After each call a non-zero result (for the device calls: HRESULT < 0) clears the flag; the loop continues. Returns 0 when the flag is still set, 1 otherwise.
map.callingConvention: __thiscall, ECX = this (the map, kept in ESI), eleven 4-byte stack arguments, callee cleans: RET 0x2C at 0x009A903A. Frame SUB ESP,8; PUSH EBP; PUSH ESI; then PUSH EBX; PUSH EDI before the loop. The result flag lives in the arg1 slot [ESP0+4]; the a9/a10 slots are reused as scratch inside the loop (the slot calls take a9 from EBX and a10 from EDI).

claims.text: C2: before the loop a1 is stored at [this+0x20] and 0x006FF9C0 is called with ECX = a2 and the name from 0x00B29F84, unconditionally, even for an empty map (the call precedes the count test).
C4: the extra-data result is used only by type-0x30000000 entries (13th argument of slot +0x5C).
C7: a null entry is skipped; a clear +0x08 ends the whole loop; register -1 with +0x24 == 0 is skipped; register -1 with +0x24 != 0 is dispatched normally.
C10: type 0x10000000 with target 1 calls device vtbl +0x178 (device, [entry+0x1C], [entry+0x30], [entry+0x20]); target 2 the same through +0x1B4; status = 1 when the HRESULT is negative.
C12: types 0x20000000 and 0x60000000 share the push sequence (a1, entry, a2..a10) and differ only in the slot (+0x54 / +0x6C).
C13: a11 goes to slot +0x5C only; slots +0x58 and +0x60 receive (a1, entry, a10) only; +0x64 receives (a1, entry, a2, a3, a6, a7, a8, a9, a10).
C14: after every dispatched call a non-zero EAX clears the flag and the loop continues; the function returns 1 when the flag was cleared.
C15: the only non-stack store is [this+0x20]; no global, no clock.
C19: the base class's slots +0x50..+0x6C are all 0x00982D85 (a _purecall-shaped stub); a plain base map is never applied with live entries of those types.
C20: pseudo.c drops the receiver of the GetExtraData call (ECX = a2) and hides the stack-slot reuse; the instructions win.
The slot targets' ret N match the pushes here: +0x58 ret 0xC, +0x5C ret 0x34, +0x60 ret 0xC, +0x64 ret 0x24, +0x6C ret 0x2C, +0x54 ret 0x2C.
